outcome: All four findings of the 2026-09-28 review resolved at b1a58fc2; one new minor finding (agent key selects last-attached, manual says last used).

leads.summary: Stop can kill an unrelated tmux session that happens to begin with omarchy-agent-
leads.consequence: The default stop command filters only a name prefix, then kills every matching session on the remote user's tmux server. For example a manually created omarchy-agent-personal-notes is terminated along with the launcher's real session, despite the documented promise to end only sessions Omarchy started; the terminal prints Ended and exit 0. It stays gone on the next launch. Mark sessions when creating them and check the marker before killing, or narrow the documented safety guarantee.
leads.triage: dropped: prefix-based by design, contrived trigger, unchanged code

leads.summary: Tmux socket permission errors are reported as no sessions running
leads.consequence: Tmux 3.7c prints `error connecting to <socket> (Permission denied)` on a failed socket connect. The `*error connecting*` wildcard treats it as no server; `omarchy agent stop` exits 0 and prints `No agent session is running`, leaving the still-running agent untouched. A later stop does the same until socket access is fixed. Match only the actual no-server cases (ECONNREFUSED / ENOENT), and surface other connection errors.
leads.triage: confirmed by coordinator (source) and Opus sandbox run review7; omitted from public draft after editorial check 1 (unusual trigger, unchanged code)

leads.summary: Two sessions attached in the same second return to the alphabetical first, not the last attached
leads.consequence: Tmux stores microseconds but `#{session_last_attached}` emits only whole seconds, and list-sessions is sorted by name. If base and Work-2 are visited in quick succession, their format values tie and `>` retains the base, so an unprompted keypress resumes the wrong conversation despite the new manual promise. Detached sessions never attached have an empty/zero value and tie too. A positive-control timestamp one second later selects Work-2, while a same-second tie selects base. Record attachment order more precisely or avoid promising last attachment when the reported timestamps tie.
leads.triage: corroborates Opus report; not a finding; not public

leads.summary: Changing or clearing the host strands sessions on the previous machine
leads.consequence: When a user changes `--host gpu-box` to `--host other-box` (or clears it), the former host value is overwritten or deleted; remote tmux sessions survive by design, but `omarchy agent stop` subsequently targets only the new host or refuses the operation for local mode. To end the older sessions the user must remember the old host and reconfigure it, then stop, then switch back. Consider a stop --host option or warn/document stopping old-host sessions before changing the setting. Source-only lifecycle lead, not run against real SSH.
leads.triage: dropped: source-only, outside changed code, low impact

leads.summary: Open PR #9350's configurable agent directory will be ignored by this PR's remote path
leads.consequence: #9350 adds `omarchy default agent-directory ~/Projects` and changes local launches from HOME to enter the chosen directory. Merging both agent scripts preserves that local `cd` but this PR's far-side script always switches to `~/Work` when it exists, so remote agents ignore the new selection and any project-specific starting directory and share Work's session. The agent script merges without markers using #9350's own base; manual and test files have textual conflicts requiring reconciliation. Conditional integration lead, not a defect in a merged release yet.
leads.triage: dropped: raised in first public review, noted in PR description

leads.summary: The new reachability helper is never exercised by the updated test
leads.consequence: The fixture replaces `omarchy-agent-host-reachable` with a logger that succeeds or fails from an environment variable. A plausible regression in the new helper, such as returning success unconditionally and never checking `ssh -G` or TCP, would still pass the suite; users would get a briefly opening/closing terminal instead of the promised unreachable-host explanation. Add isolated helper tests with mock ssh -G and a controlled timeout /dev/tcp outcome and assert the notification path uses their status.

limits: No real SSH connection or real tmux server was used. Source-level dependency checks use upstream tmux 3.7c and OpenSSH 10.5p1. Relevant head tests ran in review.py; full test/shell was not run, and current-base test/cli failed its unrelated VSCode theme assertion in the sandbox. #9350's manual and test files have merge conflicts, so no entire merged test suite was run. ## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** all four points from the [previous review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/12059#issuecomment-5862925465) are resolved at `b1a58fc2`; one minor mismatch is new.

### The agent key picks the session attached last, not used last

The key orders sessions by `#{session_last_attached}` ([`bin/omarchy-agent:238`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/b1a58fc23290c0f573bddc9458a914de6bd18f40/bin/omarchy-agent#L238)), set only on attach or switch, but the manual says it "returns to the one you were in last". **Impact:** if a prompt opens `-2` in a second window and the user keeps working in the first until both close, the key returns to `-2`; getting back takes tmux session switching.

**Suggested change:** order by `#{session_activity}` (updated on key presses) and match that format in the test's tmux mock, or reword the manual to "the one opened most recently".

<details><summary>Reproducer (real tmux 3.7c, at b1a58fc2)</summary>

Self-contained reproducer. Run from a checkout of PR head `b1a58fc2`, in a terminal (TERM set), with tmux and util-linux `script` installed. It uses a private tmux socket (`TMUX_TMPDIR` in a new temporary directory), so no existing tmux session is touched. It takes the agent key's selection loop verbatim from `bin/omarchy-agent` (lines 231-238) and models the flow the manual describes: a session is running with its window open, `omarchy agent prompt` opens `-2` in a second window, the user carries on typing in the first window, then both windows close.

The PR's own test cannot express this: its tmux mock orders sessions by attach only and has no notion of key activity, so this reproducer uses real tmux instead of a test case.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Run from a checkout of the PR head. Needs tmux and util-linux `script`.
# Uses a private tmux socket, so no existing tmux session is touched.
set -u
export TMUX_TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
unset TMUX
t() { tmux -f /dev/null "$@"; }
base=omarchy-agent-claude-Work

# The running conversation, and window A open on it.
t new-session -d -s "$base" -x 80 -y 24 sleep 600
{ sleep 4; printf 'still working here'; sleep 2; printf '\002d'; } |
  script -qfc "tmux -f /dev/null attach-session -t =$base" /dev/null >/dev/null &
window_a=$!
sleep 2

# `omarchy agent prompt` while it runs: -2 gets window B, which is then closed.
t new-session -d -s "$base-2" -x 80 -y 24 sleep 600
script -qfc "tmux -f /dev/null attach-session -t =$base-2 \; detach-client" /dev/null </dev/null >/dev/null

# Window A is typed into after that (at 4s), then closed (at 6s).
wait "$window_a"
t list-sessions -F '#{session_name}  last_attached=#{session_last_attached}  activity=#{session_activity}'
if t list-sessions -F '#{session_last_attached}' | grep -qx ''; then
  echo "setup failed: a window did not attach (is TERM set?)" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# The agent key's choice, using the selection loop from bin/omarchy-agent.
session=$base
eval "$(sed -n '/^  latest=-1$/,/^  done < <(tmux list-sessions/p' bin/omarchy-agent)"
echo "agent key attaches: $session"

t kill-server
rm -rf "$TMUX_TMPDIR"
```

Actual output at `b1a58fc2` (tmux 3.7c, util-linux 2.42.3, run in an isolated sandbox):

```text
omarchy-agent-claude-Work  last_attached=1790695172  activity=1790695178
omarchy-agent-claude-Work-2  last_attached=1790695174  activity=1790695174
agent key attaches: omarchy-agent-claude-Work-2
```

The first window was typed into last (`activity` 1790695178 is later than `-2`'s 1790695174), but the key picks `-2` because `-2` was attached later (1790695174 versus 1790695172).

Same script with only the list-sessions format in `bin/omarchy-agent` changed from `#{session_last_attached}` to `#{session_activity}`:

```text
omarchy-agent-claude-Work  last_attached=1790695178  activity=1790695184
omarchy-agent-claude-Work-2  last_attached=1790695180  activity=1790695180
agent key attaches: omarchy-agent-claude-Work
```
</details>

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Verified** (real tmux 3.7c, mostly end to end through a real `bash -lic` far side on a pty, `201ae2a5` as the control):
- Prompts `x = 1;`, `ends \;`, `two;;`, `;`, `\;`, `a\\;`, `back\`, `mid;dle` and `;;` reached the agent intact for hermes and claude. At `201ae2a5`, 7 of 9 were altered.
- With the base session ended and `-2` running, the key attaches `-2` and starts no new agent. A never-attached numbered session is resumed when it is the only one running, and lookalike names such as `omarchy-agent-pi-Work`, `...-hermes-Work2` and `...-hermes-Work-2x` are ignored.
- `stty size` output of `0 0` (on a pty), and empty, one value or non-numeric (fed to the size lines directly) give 80x24. At `201ae2a5`, a 0x0 pty failed with `width too small`.
- The unquoted `$(...)` wrapper mutant now fails both the launch test and the stop test.
- The PR test file passes on the head and on a merge with the current `quattro` tip `b421b1b4`. In the sandbox, full `test/shell` fails the same 15 files on `quattro` alone and on the merge.

</details>
